# Patch Ticker

> A free, public, no-login board of security vulnerabilities, Korean first with English alongside. It is updated every 10 minutes from the CVE List, NVD, CISA KEV, oss-security, Hacker News, GitHub, security news sites and KISA, and tells a reader whether a new vulnerability touches something they run and what to do.

Each Incident (one row; it may hold several CVEs, or none yet) has a risk level set by rules, not by a model: exploited (CISA KEV, or a source that reports attacks) or CVSS 9.0 and up is "high risk", CVSS 7.0 and up is "elevated", everything else is a notice. Summaries in Korean and English are written by Claude from the linked sources only, and every Incident links to its official advisory.

## Data

Public JSON, refreshed every 10 minutes. Please fetch each file at most once every 10 minutes; bursts are rate limited.

- [Status](https://data.patchticker.com/status.json): when the data was last updated
- [Last 7 days](https://data.patchticker.com/board/recent.json): every Incident first seen in the last week, with risk inputs, products, summaries and source links
- [Last 7 days, light](https://data.patchticker.com/board/rows.json): the same Incidents as the week file, most without details (marked `rows`), for drawing the list
- [Months](https://data.patchticker.com/index.json): the months that have data; each month is at `https://data.patchticker.com/board/YYYY-MM.json`. Only Incidents first seen in the last 90 days are kept; older ones are deleted
- [Products](https://data.patchticker.com/board/products.json): product names seen in the last 90 days

## For agents: check an inventory

To find which Incidents touch the products someone runs, ask once instead of downloading a month file:

`https://patchticker.com/api/check?products=<names>&days=<1-90>&min=<notice|high|highest>`

- `products`: 1 to 30 product names, comma-separated, as people write them ("openssh", "nginx", "Synology DSM"). Letter case, a well-known vendor in front ("Microsoft", "Apache") and a "plugin" suffix do not matter. A name with no exact match answers the products whose names start with it (at most 5, marked `"broad": true`); a name nothing matches is listed in `unmatched`.
- `days`: Incidents first seen in the last 1 to 90 days (default 30). `min`: the lowest risk level to include (default `notice`, everything).
- Each Incident: `id`, `url` (its page, or its row on the board), `first_seen`, `published`, `level` (`highest`, `high` or `notice`), `exploited`, `cvss`, `cve_count` and the first 5 `cves`, `fixed` (the fixed version, or ""), `title_en`, `title_ko`. Within one product: exploited first, then by level, then newest.
- Ask at most once every 10 minutes (the data changes no faster; answers are cached for 5 minutes). More than 30 names, or a bad `days` or `min`, answers 400 with the reason.
- Product names are sent in the URL. Nothing about a request is logged or stored by the site.

Example (values illustrative, trimmed): `https://patchticker.com/api/check?products=openssh,nginx&days=30&min=high`

```json
{"updated": "2026-11-11T12:00:00Z", "days": 30, "min": "high",
 "products": [{"asked": "openssh", "matched": ["OpenSSH"], "incidents": [
   {"id": "CVE-2026-123158", "url": "https://patchticker.com/i/CVE-2026-123158", "first_seen": "2026-11-06T00:46:00Z",
    "published": "2026-11-05T10:00:00Z", "level": "highest", "exploited": true, "cvss": 9.8, "cve_count": 1,
    "cves": ["CVE-2026-123158"], "fixed": "9.9p2", "title_en": "OpenSSH sshd authentication bypass", "title_ko": "OpenSSH sshd 인증 우회"}]},
   {"asked": "nginx", "matched": ["nginx"], "incidents": []}],
 "unmatched": [],
 "note": "Summaries are AI-written from the sources; check the linked advisory before acting. No request data is stored."}
```

## About

- [Site](https://patchticker.com/): the board itself (filters and search run in the browser)
- [Source code](https://github.com/dwamaker/PatchTicker): how the collector and the page work
- [Report a mistake](https://github.com/dwamaker/PatchTicker/issues): corrections come from readers

## Notes

- Summaries are AI-written from the sources; check the linked advisory before acting on them.
- CVE records: Copyright © 1999–2026, The MITRE Corporation, used under the CVE Terms of Use (https://www.cve.org/Legal/TermsOfUse).
- This product uses data from the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.
